ctx.x: So you went back to New York, say, early ‘49.

Yes, exactly, yeah around March or April, immediately got a job in Chubby Jackson's band up at Bop City with Tiny Kahn, you know a real swinging band. And that was, Woody was in-between bands at that time, he had broken up the Second Herd, the First Herd and hadn’t… wait a minute…
